description: Known, already-triaged production-path npm audit findings as of the 2026-11-10 production-hardening pass's Phase 1. All 17 current findings (5 high, 12 moderate) trace to multer/qs/uuid, whose only fix path is the NestJS 10->12 major upgrade this pass deliberately defers (see docs/OPEN_ITEMS.md and CLAUDE.md non-negotiable rule #10 for this pass). scripts/audit-guard.js fails CI only on a package name NOT in this list — i.e. a genuinely new finding — not on these already-known ones. Remove a package from this list the moment its underlying finding is actually fixed, so a regression back to the old version would be caught again.
